question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
Here, the correct answer is "Sufficeint."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is "Sufficeint."
 
• The spelling is **"sufficient."**
 
• "Sufficient" means as much as is necessary; enough. (जितना आवश्‍यक हो उतना; पर्याप्त)
 
 
• Example: *We have **sufficient**__ oil reserves to last for three months.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• Syrup: **a thick sweet liquid, often made by boiling sugar with water or fruit juice. (चाशनी, शीरा)
 
• **Superior: **better than usual or than somebody/something else. (सामान्‍य या अन्‍य से श्रेष्‍ठ, अधिक उत्‍कृष्‍ट)
 
• **Shrubbery: **an area where a lot of small bushes have been planted. (झाड़-झंखाड़, झुरमुट; झाड़ियों-भरा इलाक़ा)
